dailyHeadline: CAAAAM CHASES 11-0 AGAINST WITNESS PROTECTION QUEEN CARLACOTE WHILE SHIPOOPIEHOLE BURNS $5 FAAB IN 48 HOURS
dailySubhead: Fresh off a 167.26-point ambush and a Nico Collins heist, CarlaCote leads 14.8-0 in Week 11 as PrayingGrantis and Tylero0 battle for the #2 seed.
tickerTape: WEEK 10 THRILLER: 2-8 Shipoopiehole upsets Tylero0 152.56 to 152.14 by 0.42 points, then immediately drops $5 FAAB pickup Seth McGowan two days later for Chig Okonkwo.
UNDEFEATED WATCH: 10-0 Caaaam (1510.16 FPTS, 0 FAAB left) trails 6-4 CarlaCote 0-14.8 early in Week 11 after CarlaCote dropped 167.26 in Week 10.
WAIT, A 1-WIN MIRACLE: CerealStroke finally escapes the basement winless club by crushing owenriddell 164.18 to 86.52 while still sitting at $0 FAAB spent all season.
BLOCKBUSTER ROBBERY OR GENIUS?: CarlaCote lands Nico Collins and Blake Corum from PrayingGrantis in exchange for Matthew Golden right before Week 11 kickoff.
WAIVER WIRE CHAOS: Tylero0 drops $12 total FAAB on Kaelon Black, Steelers DEF, and Mark Andrews while PrayingGrantis spends $7 on Xavier Hutchinson and signs Kirk Cousins.
FIVE STRAIGHT L'S: Trade addict ELord11 falls to 3-7 after losing to CarlaCote 124.52-167.26 and faces freshly awakened CerealStroke (0-0) in Week 11.

roasts.headline: PrayingGrantis Gifts Nico Collins & Blake Corum to CarlaCote for Matthew Golden—Is Witness Protection Threatening the Superteam?
roasts.body:
Stop the Kingston campus shuttle and check the security cameras at Keaney Gym, because CarlaCote just stepped out of witness protection long enough to pull off a daylight mugging. In Week 10's freshest blockbuster, PrayingGrantis shipped Nico Collins and Blake Corum straight to CarlaCote in exchange for Matthew Golden. While PrayingGrantis leads the entire Rhody league in scoring at 1532.72 points (and somehow also leads the league in bench points left behind with 232.22), handing a borderline playoff squad a legitimate alpha receiver like Collins plus Corum for a single Packers flyer feels like paying Ryan Center concession prices for a lukewarm hot dog.

Meanwhile, CarlaCote—who has spent a grand total of $7 FAAB all year and still sits comfortably in 5th place at 6-4—just upgraded the roster right after hanging 167.26 points on ELord11. Even Caaaam, the league's resident trade-veto sheriff who blew his entire 100 FAAB budget, has to be sweating seeing CarlaCote jump out to a 14.8-0 early lead on him in Week 11 with Nico Collins waiting in the wings.

roasts.headline: Week 11 Heavyweight Clashes: Caaaam's 10-0 Perfection vs. CarlaCote's Stealth Juggernaut After Week 10's 0.42-Point Heartbreak
roasts.body:
Nobody in Kingston has recovered from Week 10's absurdity, where 2-8 Shipoopiehole took down 7-3 Tylero0 by a microscopic 152.56 to 152.14 margin—a 0.42-point loss that probably had Tylero0 sending three unsolicited fleece offers before the Monday night confetti even hit the turf. Tylero0 is already down 0-9.9 to owenriddell (who just got demolished 86.52-164.18 by CerealStroke and is riding a brutal 7-game losing streak) in Week 11, meaning another stumble could knock him right out of the top-three logjam.

At the top of the marquee, undefeated Caaaam (10-0, 1510.16 FPTS, and a league-softest 1225.56 points against) faces his toughest stealth test yet against 6-4 CarlaCote, who currently holds a 14.8-0 Week 11 edge. Elsewhere, 7-3 PrayingGrantis leads 5-5 Unanswered 19.8-6 as Unanswered desperately tries to avoid falling under .500, while 7-3 JewsInParis (on a 2-game skid) trails Shipoopiehole 0-1 in a matchup where literally one kick could swing everything.

roasts.headline: Shipoopiehole Lighting $5 FAAB on Fire for 48 Hours While CerealStroke Still Refuses to Open His Wallet
roasts.body:
If you ever wondered what pure desperation looks like at 3:07 AM in the Kingston library, look no further than the Week 10/11 waiver log. On November 18, Shipoopiehole threw down $5 FAAB to claim Colts running back Seth McGowan—only to kick him straight to the curb 48 hours later on November 20 to sign Chig Okonkwo for free. That is roughly $2.50 per day for a guy who never even saw a Sunday snap on the roster, right after Shipoopiehole also dumped the Ravens defense for Pat Bryant.

Not to be outdone in the chaos department, Tylero0 spread $12 FAAB across Kaelon Black ($4), the Pittsburgh Steelers defense ($4), and Mark Andrews ($4), tossing Keon Coleman and Juwan Johnson overboard before grabbing Jacory Croskey-Merritt and cutting Tank Dell. JewsInParis even cut bait on Jordan Addison for Elic Ayomanor, likely still haunted by that ancient Drake London-for-Jordan Mason curse. And then there is CerealStroke: still sitting on $0 FAAB spent after 11 weeks, casually grabbing Chimere Dike and the 49ers defense off the street for free right after dropping 164.18 points.

roasts.headline: Three-Way 7-3 Traffic Jam Behind Untouchable Caaaam as ELord11's Trade Addiction Spirals to Five Straight Losses
roasts.body:
The Rhody playoff race is officially divided into the haves, the lucky, and the Kingston dumpster fires. Caaaam sits alone on Mount Olympus at 10-0 with zero FAAB left in the tank, enjoying the easiest schedule luck in the league (1225.56 FPTS against). Directly below him, PrayingGrantis (1532.72 FPTS), Tylero0 (1475.48 FPTS), and JewsInParis (1450.16 FPTS) are deadlocked at 7-3, though PrayingGrantis has left an eye-watering 232.22 points rotting on his bench and JewsInParis has absorbed 1414.74 points against during a two-game skid.

CarlaCote (6-4) and Unanswered (5-5) are holding down the middle-class playoff bubble, while the bottom four are in full survival mode. ELord11 has executed more trades than half the NFL combined—flipping Puka Nacua, Josh Jacobs, Jaylen Waddle, Kyren Williams, and Omarion Hampton across the last month—and has a 3-7 record and a 5-game losing streak to show for it. Meanwhile, Shipoopiehole (2-8, league-worst 1508.6 PA), owenriddell (2-8, 7L), and CerealStroke (1-9, 1056.8 FPTS) are officially playing spoiler for free pizza at the Emporium.

powerRankings.blurb: At 10-0 with 1510.16 FPTS and a breezy 1225.56 points against, Caaaam is cruising through Kingston even with $0 FAAB left after his early-season spending spree. He trails CarlaCote 0-14.8 early in Week 11, though dropping kicker Jason Sanders without an add shows he isn't sweating yet.

Leading the entire league with 1532.72 FPTS and riding a 2-game winning streak after blasting JewsInParis 176.14-137.26, this superteam is terrifying despite leaving 232.22 bench points behind. Trading away Nico Collins and Blake Corum for Matthew Golden is a head-scratcher, though an early 19.8-6 lead over Unanswered helps.

Sitting at 7-3 with 1475.48 FPTS, Tylero0 just suffered a soul-crushing 152.14-152.56 loss to 2-8 Shipoopiehole and already trails owenriddell 0-9.9 in Week 11. At least his Week 9 fleece for Puka Nacua and a $12 waiver haul for Mark Andrews, Kaelon Black, and the Steelers DEF keep the ceiling sky-high.

Fresh off annihilating ELord11 167.26-124.52 for two straight wins, the 6-4 witness-protection specialist just stole Nico Collins and Blake Corum for Matthew Golden. With only $7 FAAB used all season and a 14.8-0 early lead on undefeated Caaaam, the league should be terrified.

Despite a strong 7-3 record and 1450.16 FPTS, a 2-game losing streak and 1414.74 points against have the ghosts of the Drake London-for-Jordan Mason trade whispering again. Dropping Jordan Addison for Elic Ayomanor right before facing 2-8 Shipoopiehole (currently 0-1) feels like classic mid-November panic.

Sitting squarely at 5-5 with 1294.5 FPTS and zero FAAB remaining after a 123.66-158.32 loss to Caaaam, Unanswered is dangerously close to slipping below .500. Already trailing PrayingGrantis 6-19.8 in Week 11, that Week 9 haul of Josh Jacobs and Jaylen Waddle needs to carry immediately.

A compulsive trader's nightmare: five consecutive losses have sunk ELord11 to 3-7 (1289.3 FPTS) despite constantly reshuffling stars like A.J. Brown, Drake London, Garrett Wilson, and Trey McBride. Tied 0-0 against 1-9 CerealStroke in Week 11, another L makes this an official lost season.

Shocked the league by edging Tylero0 152.56-152.14 for a second win, though 1508.6 points against has kept this 2-8 roster buried in 8th. Spending $5 FAAB on Seth McGowan only to drop him two days later for Chig Okonkwo proves the front office is running on pure vibes.

Break out the champagne in Kingston—after nine straight losses and a league-low 1056.8 FPTS, CerealStroke erupted for 164.18 points to flatten owenriddell for win number one. Still refusing to spend a single dollar of FAAB while streaming Chimere Dike and the 49ers DEF is stubbornly iconic.

Seven straight defeats, a humiliating 86.52-point faceplant against previously winless CerealStroke, and just 1155.18 FPTS on the year put owenriddell dead last in the power rankings. An early 9.9-0 Week 11 lead over Tylero0 and adding the Lions DEF offer a tiny glimmer of hope to stop the bleeding.

tradeGrades.summary: CarlaCote received Nico Collins (WR - HOU) and Blake Corum (RB - LAR); PrayingGrantis received Matthew Golden (WR - GB)
tradeGrades.verdict: CarlaCote rarely leaves witness protection, and when she does, she steals a legitimate WR1 in Nico Collins plus RB depth in Blake Corum for Matthew Golden. PrayingGrantis already has a stacked 1532.72-point superteam, making this charitable donation completely baffling.

tradeGrades.summary: ELord11 received Drake London (WR - ATL) and Garrett Wilson (WR - NYJ); Tylero0 received Puka Nacua (WR - LAR)
tradeGrades.verdict: Tylero0 consolidated two volatile wideouts into the ultimate weekly sledgehammer in Puka Nacua, classic fleece-hunter behavior that actually worked. ELord11 got solid depth in Drake London and Garrett Wilson, yet promptly kept losing anyway.

tradeGrades.summary: Unanswered received Josh Jacobs (RB - GB) and Jaylen Waddle (WR - DEN); ELord11 received A.J. Brown (WR - NE)
tradeGrades.verdict: ELord11's trade addiction struck again, shipping away a bellcow RB in Josh Jacobs plus Jaylen Waddle just to get A.J. Brown in a Patriots uniform. Unanswered easily got the deeper, safer package for a 5-5 playoff push.

tradeGrades.summary: ELord11 received Trey McBride (TE - ARI) and Emeka Egbuka (WR - TB); owenriddell received Kyren Williams (RB - LAR), Omarion Hampton (RB - LAC), and Tyler Warren (TE - IND)
tradeGrades.verdict: Getting two starting-caliber running backs in Kyren Williams and Omarion Hampton plus Tyler Warren for Trey McBride and Emeka Egbuka looked like great value on paper for owenriddell. Unfortunately, both teams have combined for a 5-15 record since, proving you can't out-trade bad lineup luck.
